content.title: Causes of heart failure, common modes of presentation and specific investigations

table_rows.Examples of presentations: Myocardial infarction; Angina or angina-equivalent; Arrhythmias
table_rows.Specific investigations: Invasive coronary angiography; CT coronary angiography; Imaging stress tests (echo, nuclear, CMR)

table_rows.Examples of presentations: Heart failure with preserved systolic function; Malignant hypertension/acute pulmonary oedema
table_rows.Specific investigations: 24 h ambulatory BP; Plasma metanephrines, renal artery imaging; Renin and aldosterone

table_rows.Examples of presentations: Primary valve disease (e.g., aortic stenosis); Secondary valve disease (functional regurgitation); Congenital valve disease

table_rows.Specific investigations: Ambulatory ECG recording; Electrophysiology study if indicated

table_rows.Examples of presentations: Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive cardiomyopathies; ARVC; Peripartum; Takotsubo syndrome; Toxin-related (alcohol, cocaine, iron, copper)
table_rows.Specific investigations: CMR; genetic testing; right and left heart catheterisation; angiography; trace elements/toxicology; LFTs, GGT

table_rows.Examples of presentations: Congenitally corrected/repaired transposition of great arteries; Shunt lesions; Repaired tetralogy of Fallot; Ebstein's anomaly
Viral myocarditis; Chagas disease; HIV; Lyme disease
Anthracyclines; Trastuzumab; VEGF inhibitors; Immune checkpoint inhibitors; Proteasome inhibitors; RAF + MEK inhibitors

table_rows.Specific investigations: Serum electrophoresis and serum free light chains; Bence Jones protein; Bone scintigraphy; CMR; CT-PET; EMB; Serum ACE; FDG-PET; chest CT

genes.context: Listed under 'Infiltrative' investigations as 'Serum ACE' alongside CMR and FDG-PET for evaluation of amyloid/sarcoidosis/neoplastic causes
